title: Crispy Chow Fun Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry dish made with crispy chow fun noodles and a variety of vegetables.

ingredients.name: Warm oil
ingredients.notes: such as vegetable or peanut oil

instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced potato and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced Chinese broccoli and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the crisp chow fun noodles and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
